3.8. ASSOCIATED PRIMES 85
Definition 3.7.7. An R -module M is finitely presented if it is finitely
generated and the kernel of the surjection from some finitely generated free
module onto M is finitely generated.
Proposition 3.7.8. Let R be a commutative ring, and P a finitely presented
R -module. Then P is projective if and only if P p is projective for all prime
ideals p ⊂ R, and this holds if and only if P m is projective for all maximal
